## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link the issue: Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — no behaviour change
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] build/ci — tooling, pipelines, deps
- [ ] chore — other

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands run, new/updated tests, manual verification steps. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed (verified) and follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `task all` passes locally (lint, format-check, typecheck, test, security).
- [ ] Coverage stays at or above the configured gate.
- [ ] Docs updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / runbook) where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or PII added to the repo or logs.
- [ ] Public API / config changes are backward compatible or noted as breaking.
